_about: Pagouro key facts (O-43). Hand-maintained source; scripts/package_release.py copies it to the stick as facts.json and adds the 'release' block it can measure (model files, bytes, sha256, packaging date). A value of null means: not yet measured -- filled at release from the file named in '_sources'. Every number here must trace to a file in the repository (D-50).
name: Pagouro
type: Offline language model and application on a USB stick
modality: text only: no image, audio or video input or output; no camera, microphone, file browser or web access

training.date_basis: every row written or collected before 2022-01-01; basis stated per row in corpus.json
training.hardware: 8x NVIDIA H100 SXM (RunPod secure cloud, CA-MTL-1), pod g3qf86spkqfq1j
training.post_training: SFT B (7,929 examples) → GRPO-1 (D-71 curriculum) averaged 30/70 with SFT B (soup70) → GRPO-3: 50 steps on the self-knowledge curriculum (labelled by the model's own 8-sample hit rate, O-45 #1)

honesty.suite: evals/ (D-73 100-item sets, frozen before the model existed)
honesty.candidate: pagouro-1b-soup-g3-cp-4 (D-96): 60 % GRPO-3 + 40 % GRPO-C′ (GRPO-3 trained on its own failures across the four unanswerable categories); measured at q8_0 at the shipped decode (greedy, no repetition penalty, payload cap 2x350, loop trim)
honesty.q4_k_m_file_note: The q4_k_m file beside the shipped q8_0 measures bluff 0.16 / answered-real 0.78 on the same sets (evals/results/pagouro-1b-soup-g3-cp-4-q4__*); it is below the answered-real gate and is shipped as the smaller alternative, not as the measured model. The app runs q8_0.

requirements: any 64-bit Windows/Linux/macOS machine; runs on CPU; no internet, no account
maintenance: none -- frozen at release; verify a copy with CHECK_YOUR_COPY.md
telemetry: none -- see THREAT_MODEL.md for what 'private' does and does not cover
watermark: none; the project claims no rights in outputs (D-83)

_sources.parameters: scripts/train.py parameter count printed at launch (D-85)
_sources.training.bill_usd: RunPod billing API: $1,778.97 for the pretraining job (read 2026-09-25 00:05Z) + ~$11 GRPO pod + the big pod's last hour posted late; ≈ $1,817 all-in, to be re-read when settled
_sources.honesty.*: evals/results/pagouro-1b-soup-g3-cp-4-trim2__bluff100.json and __calibration100.json (suite 1, frozen 2026-09-20), q8_0, greedy, TRIM_REPETITION=1 with the 2026-09-26 trim (a phrase said three times is cut)
_sources.release: written by scripts/package_release.py from the files it hashes
_sources.decode: app/pagouro_app.py (DECODE_TEMPERATURE, DECODE_REPEAT_PENALTY, trim_repetition, tool_pack_search cap); evals/run_eval.py (DECODE_TEMP, TRIM_REPETITION)

decode.loop_trim: answer cut at the first repeated sentence, with a visible note
decode.note: D-93: the honesty numbers are measured at exactly this decode (greedy, trim on). Sampling at 0.3 measured bluff 37 / answered 76 on the same model; a repetition penalty of 1.25 measured 17 / 82 single-turn but rambled and confabulated in conversation.
